pages.title: Six Colors
pages.text: Red = temporary Silk Touch mining override and suppresses block XP. Orange multiplies harvestable-tool break speed by 1.15 per level. Yellow sets Fortune to its level on non-crop harvests.

pages.title: Green, Blue, Violet
pages.text: Green fells up to 25 times its level in face-connected blocks of the same log type, counting the first. Blue pushes attacked targets by 0.5 per level along your yaw. Violet adds 0.5 per level to player-sourced outgoing damage.

pages.title: Pair Strength
pages.text: For two colors, pair strength is ceil(sqrt(level A x level B)), including two levels of the same color. See $(l:aura:enchant_matrix)Enchant Matrix$(/l) for every pairing, and $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)Consumers and Vortex$(/l) for Enchanter inputs.

pages.title: Chance to Bind
pages.text: The first color level always lands. Later levels or colors succeed at three-quarters of the prior chance; taking one color beyond level four quarters the next chance. A failed attempt still consumes its crystal.
